notes: Toy configuration for VS3 Task 9 planted fixture BR-WILD-1 (.kiro spec ascension-trials-scalable-two-player-analysis): a Wild-legality best-response case where a Wild unit DOES legally raise a Trial total on one Trial and does NOT on another (REQ-7.3 'Wild that does/does not legally raise a Trial total').

Two energy domains (void, flux). Trial 'purity' is mono (source_count class:energy minimum 1 maximum 1, reward first=6); Trial 'harmony' requires TWO energy sources (source_count class:energy minimum 2, reward first=6). Wild is enabled, requires a legal normal entry, and is included in the primary total. Optional allocation, winner-take-all with shared-full ties, local total_power tiebreak decides contested Trials, no final tiebreak.

Acting side A holds void=1 and Wild=1 (one energy source). Fixed opponent B holds void=1 and plays it on 'purity'. On 'purity' (mono) A's entry {void:1}+Wild:1 is legal and Wild raises A's total from 1 to 2, beating B's total 1 on the total_power tiebreak: A wins purity outright (6) instead of a shared-full tie (6-6). On 'harmony' A has only one energy source, so any A entry there is illegal (Wild is never a source and cannot satisfy the 2-source minimum); the Wild is dropped and the entry scores 0 -- Wild cannot legally raise a total it may not join. Hand oracle: A's best response is {void:1, Wild:1} on 'purity' -> margin +6, win +1; the Wild is decisive (without it purity ties 6-6, margin 0). Oracle transcribed from the Wild rules (model v2.1 §4.3; spec v1.1 §7.3 A10), not reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).
